name: Microservice Intrusion Detection Benchmark
description: A benchmark and dataset for evaluating intrusion detection systems applied to microservice applications using logs/traffic and case study scenarios.
evaluation_method: F1 (primary), with precision/recall and AUC reported
reputation: A domain-specific dataset for microservice IDS research; referenced in niche cybersecurity and microservice communities but not a broadly established standard.
notes: Dataset derives from case-study scenarios and simulated traffic; may have class imbalance and limited scale compared to large real-world deployments; results can be sensitive to logging fidelity and feature engineering.
